usage: agentware decide [-h] [--format {text,json}] --topic TOPIC
                        --summary SUMMARY --options OPTIONS --choice CHOICE
                        --rationale RATIONALE --reversible REVERSIBLE
                        [--tags TAGS] [--author AUTHOR] [--to-shared]
                        [--force]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --topic TOPIC         filename stem under decisions/ (free text is
                        normalized to a hyphenated slug)
  --summary SUMMARY     one-line summary
  --options OPTIONS     options that were weighed
  --choice CHOICE       the option chosen
  --rationale RATIONALE
                        why this choice, in-scope per R-AUTO-01
  --reversible REVERSIBLE
                        how reversible the decision is
  --tags TAGS           comma-separated extra tags ('decision' auto-added)
  --author AUTHOR       provenance author handle (default: the per-user handle
                        if set, else the operator handle)
  --to-shared           write org-wide into shared/ (curator only, CR-gated)
  --force               record even if a near-duplicate existing decision is
                        detected
